helpful: The provisioned document texts were the decisive input: having the SG's actual merits-brief summary of argument (inside brief-in-opposition.txt) and the full petition made the doctrinal forecast concrete rather than inferred from docket entries.
The statpack merits section's per-Term table with the excluded column made the pooled strictly-prior baseline a five-minute computation.
gaps: A merits cell would benefit from the petitioner's merits brief and reply being provisioned the way the cert-stage documents are — the document pipeline fetched only cert-kind documents, so petitioner's merits-stage theory had to be inferred from the petition.

A cases-citing-this-authority search (citation graph) would have answered 'how have this Court's recent channeling cases come out' from the corpus; the --citation filter is own-cites-only and sparse, so it returned nothing for Johnson v. Robison.
notes: The provisioned brief-in-opposition.txt concatenates two distinct filings (the Mar 6 cert-stage BIO and the Jul 13 merits brief for respondent) under one cert-stage kind with truncated: true — usable, and in fact valuable, but mislabeled; flagged in flags.json.
